We're going in.|Saesee Tiin, during the Battle of Lola Sayu|{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}}} '''Saesee Tiin''', a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Iktotchi]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[moon]] [[Iktotch]], was a [[Jedi Master]] who served on the [[Jedi High Council]] during the [[Republic Era|last]] [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. A skilled [[lightsaber combat]]ant and [[starfighter]] [[pilot]], Tiin fought in the [[Clone Wars]] as a [[Jedi General]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. He and [[Agen Kolar]] were [[Death|slain]] by [[Darth Sidious]] and became the first victims of the [[Great Jedi Purge]] shortly before fellow [[Jedi]] Master [[Kit Fisto]] when a team of High Council members, organized by [[Mace Windu]] who was betrayed by [[Anakin Skywalker]] shortly before [[Darth]] Sidious killed Windu as well, [[Duel in Palpatine's office|confronted]] the [[Sith Lord]], who was revealed to be the true identity of [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, who would proceed to [[Order 66|destroy]] the Jedi Order. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|I was a ''frustrating'' Padawan. I never listened, never took to the public part of things.|Saesee Tiin|''[[The Living Force]]''}} [[File:SaeseeTiinJediMaster-SWCT.png|thumb|right|220px|Saesee Tiin was a quiet, courageous Jedi Master.]] A [[Gender|male]] [[Iktotchi]] hailing from [[moon]] [[Iktotch]], Saesee Tiin served the [[Jedi Order]].{{ForceCollection|Saesee Tiin|star=4}} Tiin was the [[Padawan]] to [[Omo Bouri]], an esteemed [[Jedi Master]]. By his own later admission, Tiin was a "frustrating" Padawan as he had a habit of refusing to listen to orders. Between [[50 BBY]] and [[42 BBY]],In "[[Choices]]," [[Mace Windu]] gained a seat on the [[Jedi High Council]]. {{Film|III}} established that [[Anakin Skywalker]] was the youngest to ever serve on the Council. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the film to [[19 BBY]], while ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' establishes that Skywalker was born in [[41 BBY]]. Therefore, Windu must have been at least twenty-two years old. According to the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' booklet "[[Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force]]," Mace Windu was born 40 years before the [[Battle of Naboo]], which ''Star Wars: Galactic Atlas'' places in [[32 BBY]]. Therefore, Windu gained a seat on the Council not before [[50 BBY]]. The episode takes place before Dooku left the [[Jedi Order]]. ''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' places Dooku's departure from the Jedi Order to forty-two [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[42 BBY]] according to ''Star Wars: Galactic Atlas''. Therefore "Choices" takes place between these years. Tiin attended the [[Funeral of Katri|funeral]] of Jedi Master [[Katri]], who was killed by a group of [[security guard]]s on [[Raxus Secundus]].{{TOTJ|Choices}} He took part in the [[Stark Hyperspace War]]. He was eventually promoted to the rank of Jedi Master and gained a seat on the [[Jedi High Council]]''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' by [[40 BBY]]. In that year,''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of ''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' in [[40 BBY]]. Tiin was present at a Council debate over the dispute between the [[Czerka Arms]] and the [[Pijali monarchy]]. ===Mission to Kwenn=== {{Quote|Do not laugh.''"
"''Have I ever?''"
"''I suppose not.|Plo Koon and Saesee Tiin|}} In [[33 BBY]],{{LivingForceDate}} Saesee Tiin was spending much of his time working on the Jedi Order's various starships and surface vehicles, including interacting with contractors and droids, and leading work crews of Jedi students. Tiin was present at a council meeting in which [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] challenged the council to pay more attention to individuals in the galaxy and the [[living Force]], stating that the Jedi Order was so focused on large-scale issues that they had lost sight of the smaller things in front of them. When it was suggested that the next closure would be the [[Kwenn Jedi outpost|outpost]] on the planet [[Kwenn]], which had been open for 200 years and was the result of significant Jedi effort, the council determined to meet in person on Kwenn before making the decision. They would plan an anniversary celebration for the people of Kwenn, in an effort to meet Jinn's challenge. ====Labor dispute==== {{Quote|We are Jedi. Our job is to keep the peace. ''This is not peace!''|Saesee Tiin|}} Tiin and Master [[Plo Koon]] traveled to Kwenn together on a Jedi shuttle, landing at the spaceport on [[Capital Key]]. With no mission other than a vague aim to render aid, the two hailed a [[Kwikhaul Livery Corporation|Kwikhaul]] [[landspeeder]] taxi driven by the droid [[SK-89]]. Koon directed the droid to take them to the [[Bivall Colony]] on [[Parva Key]], which he had visited long before, as it was likely that the [[Bivall]] refugees there could use some sort of aid. When SK-89 sped through an intersection and nearly hit another vehicle, Tiin and Koon discovered that this was her first time ever driving. Halfway through their trip, while they were on [[Zyboh Key]], four other speeders boxed them in and began bumping them. At this point, Tiin took over driving and attempted to escape their attackers, but more speeders joined the chase. Then, Tiin found his controls unresponsive because The speeder was being autopiloted back to the [[Kwikhaul complex|Kwikhaul depot]]. At the depot, the drivers and passengers of the other speeders formed a mob around them, and SK-89 informed them that it was she, not the Jedi, who were the target of their anger. Tiin and Koon discovered that they had stumbled into the middle of a labor dispute at Kwikhaul. The owner, [[Fraxa]], had replaced all the drivers with droids that morning, and the former employees had stormed the compound and destroyed the droids inside. Fraxa demanded that the Jedi arrest the workers for destroying private property. Instead, they listened to both points of view. Fraxa argued that she could no longer afford to employ organic drivers. The workers argued that the droids she was using were unsafe, and that Fraxa had plenty of money for herself. She replied that tourism and industry were waning on Kwenn, leaving less business for Kwikhaul. Tiin halted the argument by pointing out that Kwikhaul's landspeeders could easily be repurposed to run on the water, allowing them to be used as water taxis and oceanic tourism craft. He offered to help with the retrofit. Then, he noticed the fleet of unused touring buses, and suggested they be modified and used by the droids to collect garbage off the streets. He offered to contact the droid mechanic [[Heezo]] at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant to assist with repairing the droids which the workers had destroyed. These new initiatives satisfied both Fraxa and the Kwikhaul workers, and the two Jedi helped get the work started. ====Rendering aid==== {{Quote|The Order two centuries ago took the extreme step of bringing this entire planet back from the edge. But we may do it no favors by trying to prolong its lifespan. You and I would agree anyone attempting to use the Force to lengthen life would be committing a crime of the highest order.|Saesee Tiin, to Plo Koon|}} During the Jedi Council's time on Kwenn, Tiin and Koon continued working with Kwikhaul. Tiin delivered a [[Speeder bus|speederbus]] to transport the group of teens which Master [[Even Piell]] had taken charge of, and gave the teens a lesson in mechanics while he was there. Koon and Tiin helped with Master [[Oppo Rancisis]]' rescue of a beached [[Teal oroko|oroko]]; Tiin used girders to connect several [[repulsorcraft]] engines together into an open-framed flying platform and attempted to lift the oroko with cables. This idea failed because the terrified creature's grip on the ground increased as the cables were pulled. Instead, Koon and Tiin devised a plan to bring the ocean to the oroko. They set the hovering platform to spin and sabotaged the engines before swimming away. The platform crashed into the ocean, sending up a plume of water which the Jedi directed toward the beach with the Force, allowing the oroko to follow the wave back into the water. Afterward, Tiin and Koon discussed the effectiveness of the Council's visit to Kwenn, with the former considering the endeavor fruitless and the latter disagreeing. ====The Bicentennial Celebration==== {{Quote|The point is that people sometimes need comforting tones—but then other times they need something else. To hear the truth directly, from someone who does not cushion the blow. To hear from someone who who assumes that all living beings should strive for competence—and who expects people to learn from their mistakes. When that is what they need, Saesee Tiin must be ready. It would be a terrible shame if he was always unavailable, in the conference chamber, garage, or hangar.|Plo Koon, to Saesee Tiin|}} Thanks to various sources of intelligence, the Jedi were aware ahead of time that the allied pirate gangs led by [[Zilastra]] planned to attack Kwenn on Celebration Day. Tiin contributed his flying skills to the defense efforts, borrowing [[Fraxa's ARC-8 starfighter]] after finishing up the restoration she'd been working on. He engaged with pirates in airspeeders over the water, alerting the Coastal Watch to downed craft before he had even started fighting. The fighter's 8 wings made it harder to steer in the wind, so even though Tiin intended to only hit glancing blows, he destroyed several of the pirate airspeeders. The pirates were later rescued from the ocean by the Coastal Watch. When some of the pirates made for land on [[Capital Key]], Tiin followed and left the [[ARC-8 starfighter|ARC-8]] to fight on land. He declined assistance when contacted by Koon. Before returning to Coruscant, Tiin and Koon made repairs on Fraxa's ARC-8. Koon felt very satisfied with all the work the Jedi had done on Kwenn, but Tiin only looked ahead to all his unfinished work back on Coruscant. The upgrade of the Jedi fleet was still in progress, and he wanted to solve a software error on Jinn's shuttle. Koon expressed to Tiin that despite Tiin's gruff and sometimes antisocial nature, he was good at telling people the unadorned truth when they needed to hear it, and should make sure he wasn't always holed up in a hangar or meeting. ===A new threat=== In [[32 BBY]], the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] was [[Invasion of Naboo|blockaded]]. Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been sent by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] to end the blockade alongside his Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], came before the Council after rescuing [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and bringing her to [[Coruscant]]. He told the Council that he believed he had [[Duel on Tatooine|encountered]] a [[Sith Lord]] on [[Tatooine]] and that a [[Slavery|slave]] he freed, [[Anakin Skywalker]], was the [[Chosen One]]. While many on the Council were skeptical of Jinn's claims, Tiin considered it possible. Nevertheless, the Council ultimately denied him permission to train Anakin due to him being too old. After Jinn's [[death]] during the [[Battle of Naboo]] at the hands of [[Maul|Darth Maul]], Tiin and the rest of the Council attended his [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn|funeral]] and decided to let Kenobi train Skywalker, fulfilling Jinn's dying wish. Darth Maul's personal craft, the [[Scimitar|Sith Infiltrator]] ''[[Scimitar]]'' was recovered by the [[Galactic Republic]]. After self-defense mechanisms [[Death|killed]] the first [[technician]]s to inspect it, Master Tiin was called in to help secure the vessel. Large amounts of [[spy]]ing equipment was found, but the [[computer]] systems were erased. The ''Scimitar'' was then recovered by [[Darth Sidious]],{{BuildFalconCite|44|Starship Fact File}} Maul's [[Sith Master]] and publicly known as the recently elected [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine,{{Film|I}} while on its way to [[Kuat Drive Yards]] for further inspection. ===The Clone Wars=== ====Outbreak of war==== [[File:Saesee_Tiin_Geonosis.png|thumb|left|300px|Saesee Tiin stands among fellow surviving Jedi during the battle of Geonosis|alt=]] In [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Tiin was a [[Jedi assault team|participant]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars]] against fallen Jedi and now [[Sith]] Lord [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and the newly-formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with their armies of [[battle droid]]s. Tiin, unlike many others in the battle, survived, having escaped the [[Petranaki Arena]] alongside [[Mace Windu]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and went on to become a [[Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Sometime after the war's outbreak, Tiin was present alongside the rest of the Jedi Council at a meeting in which they gave Windu a task. [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] scouts had discovered that the Confederacy had occupied the planet [[Hissrich]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], which the council began to fear that the Confederacy was to utilize the planet as a staging area for assaults on neighboring [[star system]]s. In hopes of determining the threat level, Windu, alongside fellow Jedi Masters [[Kit Fisto]], [[Tenth Brother|Prosset Dibs]], and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Rissa Mano]] were tasked with running a covert mission to acquire the information.[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 1|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 1]] Later, Tiin was once again present at another meeting, where Windu reported that he was successful in his mission.[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 5|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 5]] At one point, Tiin was talking to his Jedi friend in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]]. It was then that [[Ahsoka Tano]] and Skywalker's conversation caught their attention.{{TOTJ|Practice Makes Perfect (episode)}} [[File:MasterHalseyReturned-WOTM.png|thumb|right|330px|Tiin joined Gallia, Kenobi, and Koon in receiving the bodies of Master Halsey and Knox.]] During the Clone Wars, Tiin was present at the Jedi Temple when [[Delta Squad]] brought back the bodies of Jedi Master [[Halsey]] and his apprentice [[Knox]] who were killed in the [[Devaron massacre|massacre]] on [[Devaron]]. [[Adi Gallia]] suspected it was the work of the presumed dead [[Asajj Ventress]], however Jedi Master [[Plo Koon]] suspected it was a newly appointed Sith Lord. Obi-Wan Kenobi, on the other hand, suspected it was the work of a monstrous animal. The mysterious killer was revealed to be the former [[Nightbrothers|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress]], which surprised Kenobi as Opress appeared similar to Darth Maul who he had [[Battle of Naboo|supposedly beaten on Naboo]] [[32 BBY|years before]].{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}} ===Clone Wars continues=== ====Battles of Lola Sayu and Mon Cala==== {{Quote|There have not been battles like these since the days of the Old Republic.|Saesee Tiin|}} [[File:SaeseeTiin-CitadelRescue.png|thumb|left|330px|Tiin flying his starfighter during the Battle of Lola Sayu]] In [[20 BBY]], Tiin took part in the [[Battle of Lola Sayu|rescue]] of [[Even Piell]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] and his men from the [[Citadel]] [[prison]] on [[Lola Sayu]] in which they were imprisoned, due to the fact that they were carrying [[Nexus Route|vital information]] of [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace]] coordinates that could change the scale of the war to the faction in possession of the said secret information. Piell was killed by an [[Anooba]] that pounced on him. Tiin alongside Adi Gallia, Plo Koon, and Kit Fisto, rescued what remained of the team and returned with them to Coruscant. Jedi [[ace]]s including Skywalker, [[Plo Koon]], and Tiin modified their [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]] as the war waged on, with updates passing to other Jedi [[pilot]]s.{{HelmetCollectionCite|33|Databank A-Z}} Later, Fisto, Skywalker, and their [[clone trooper]]s were trapped on [[Mon Cala]] in a losing [[Battle of Mon Cala|battle]] against their opposition's superior strength provided by Separatist commander [[Riff Tamson]]. Fisto and the others managed to contact the Jedi Temple with a faint signal, yet it was too weak and within moments collapsed. Windu understood the broken communication as sign of the Republic's impending defeat, however, noting that it would take a considerable amount of time to train any new [[Clone SCUBA trooper|SCUBA troopers]] to send and reinforce them, the situation was dire. On this topic, [[Yoda]] recommended that they should ask help from a suitable ally of the Republic. Master Tiin suggested they contact the [[Gungan]]s, an amphibious [[species]] who had a standing [[Gungan Grand Army|army]], were friendly with the Republic, and also were located near [[Mon Cala]]. The Gungan Grand Army agreed to help and provided Republic reinforcements{{TCW|Gungan Attack}} that later helped them win the battle.{{TCW|Prisoners}} ====Umbara and the Order in disarray==== {{Quote|You have shown such great strength and resilience in your struggle to prove your innocence.|Saesee Tiin, to Ahsoka Tano|{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}}} After taking part in the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Saesee Tiin)|Battle of Mon Calamari]],{{HelmetCollectionCite|55|Databank A-Z}} Tiin joined Anakin Skywalker, [[Pong Krell]], and Obi-Wan Kenobi for the [[Battle of Umbara]] with [[Pong Krell]] and Master Tiin's troops supporting Kenobi's troops in the south of the planet.{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} Tiin was present during the [[funeral of Obi-Wan Kenobi]], which was in fact a plot created by the Council to infiltrate the ranks of [[bounty hunter]]s and discover a plan created by Count Dooku to capture Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], which succeeded as Skywalker and Windu were able to prevent the Chancellor's assassination on Naboo.{{TCW|Deception}} Tiin was present at the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims|funeral]] for the victims of the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing of the Jedi Temple]], where in fact the [[Barriss Offee|culprit]] of the bombing was hiding among the present Jedi, [[Admiral]]s and [[Politics|political]] figures.{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} [[File:FauxFuneral-Deception.png|thumb|right|330px|Tiin took part in the ruse of of Obi-Wan Kenobi's death.]] In [[19 BBY]], Tiin also partook in deciding the expulsion of Jedi fugitive [[Ahsoka Tano]] after the bombing where he, along with Masters Windu and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], did not believe Tano was innocent of the crime. Tiin noted that Tano had been found with [[NM-K reconstitutor|nano-droid]] explosives, the same devices used in the bombing, which he felt alone was enough for her to be convicted. In the end, however, Tano's name was cleared after Barriss Offee, the actual bomber was uncovered by Anakin Skywalker. Tano was offered a [[Jedi Knight|place]] back in the Order, but refused. ====Yoda's visions and Vos==== Tiin was present when Master Yoda felt he was hearing a voice from beyond the grave, but the combined power of all of the Council members could not find anything. Yoda left Coruscant after this without the Council's express permission. On the planet [[Dagobah]], Yoda had a vision that Tiin engaged in a [[lightsaber duel]] with [[Darth]] Sidious and was killed when Sidious stabbed him.{{TCW|Voices}} Tiin was also present with [[Akar-Deshu]] and some of his council counterparts discussing [[Quinlan Vos]]'s fall to the dark side.''[[Dark Disciple]]'' ===End of the war and death=== [[File:The_Death_of_Saesee_Tiin.png|thumb|left|330px|Tiin's death at the hands of Darth Sidious]] Tiin continued to participate in the Clone Wars, including the pivotal [[Battle of Coruscant]]{{BuildFalconCite|58|Secrets of Spaceflight}} later that year, where thousands of Republic and Separatist ships fought above the Republic capital world.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' During the battle, clone troopers from the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Impavid]]'' under the command of General Tiin launched an assault on the Separatist [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] ''[[Prosperous]]'' and captured it. Separatist [[Head of State]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] was killed during the battle, and [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Commander]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] escaped to [[Utapau]], where General Kenobi ultimately killed the [[cyborg]] Separatist leader. As the [[Battle of Utapau]] commenced, Tiin was one of four Council members sent to arrest Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, now revealed by Anakin Skywalker to be the powerful Sith Lord Darth Sidious, alongside Fisto, [[Agen Kolar]], and Windu. Sidious, however, [[Duel in Palpatine's office|resisted]] his arrest, instead pulling out [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers|his]] [[Color|red]] [[lightsaber]] and engaging the group of Jedi in [[Lightsaber combat|combat]]. Despite the skills of the Jedi Masters, the Sith Lord quickly cut down Kolar and Tiin before engaging Windu and Fisto in a brief duel, only Windu living to continue the fight. Skywalker then also arrived and intervened to save the Chancellor, leading to Windu being unable to further resist Sidious' [[Force lightning]] and being thrown out the window. Skywalker then fully succumbed to the [[Dark side of the Force]] and was christened as Darth Vader.{{Film|III}} ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Master Tiin!|A mourner shouting Tiin's name during the procession in the Holy City|''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''}} Tiin, Kolar, Fisto and Windu would become the first victims of the [[Great Jedi Purge]]. After their failed assassination attempt, Sidious would use the situation to brand the Jedi as traitors to the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|declare]] the rise of the totarlitairan [[Galactic Empire]]. The Great Jedi Purge saw Sidious activate the [[Order 66]] protocol, turning the clone troopers against the Jedi, and Darth Vader [[Operation: Knightfall|marching into the Jedi Temple]] with the [[501st Legion]]. Afterwards Vader used the [[Jedi beacon]] to broadcast a signal to any surviving Jedi to lure them to the Temple where they would be murdered by the clone troopers stationed there. [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]],{{SW|url=news/hidden-knowledge-5-fascinating-facts-about-the-jedi-temple|text=Hidden Knowledge: 5 Fascinating Facts about the Jedi Temple|nolive=1}} who had witnessed the massacre at the Temple first hand, discovered a beacon inside [[Saesee Tiin's ship|Saesee Tiin's ship]] and managed to warn Kenobi and Grand Master Yoda, who subsequently returned to Coruscant and [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple|infiltrated the Jedi Temple]] and altered the transmission to a [[Hologram|holographic]] recording of Kenobi warning all remaining Jedi to keep away.[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']] In the wake of the Jedi Order's eradication and the rise of the Galactic Empire, [[Bombing in the Holy City|a procession of mourners gathered]] in [[Jedha]]'s [[Jedha City|Holy City]] to grieve the fallen Jedi. Among them were cries mourning Jedi Saesee Tiin, [[Stass Allie]], [[O'ra've]] and [[Caladastorous]] were heard. Organa was present for the event and thought of joining in the chorus, but feared that his cries would bring back the "ghosts" haunting him. Shortly after the [[Battle of Fortress Vader]], Vader entered a [[portal]] constructed by [[Darth Momin]] to resurrect his wife Padmé Amidala. While walking through [[Force vision|visions]], he encountered Tiin along with many Jedi he had known in his life as Anakin, with their lightsabers ignited ready to battle him. However, Vader killed all the illusions, first impaling Tiin through the chest as the words "let the past die" resounded in his mind.[[Darth Vader (2017) 25|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 25]] Over five decades later during the time of the [[First Order]], [[Dok-Ondar]] owned a statue of Saesee Tiin in his [[Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities|Den of Antiquities]] in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on [[Batuu]].{{GEAttr|Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Competence is not enough.|Saesee Tiin|}} [[File:SaeseeTiin-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|right|200px|Tiin was skilled with the lightsaber.]] Saesee Tiin was an [[Iktotchi]] male who stood 1.93 [[meter]]s—or six [[Foot|feet]] and four inches—tall. Tiin was regarded as a legendary warrior among the Jedi High Council.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' He was steadfast and courageous, though he rarely spoke and generally kept to himself,{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Saesee Tiin - Jedi Master}} as he chose his words carefully as he quietly listened to debates and reflected on the Force's [[Cosmic Force|will]]. Athough Tiin could be gruff and was not known for being particularly personable, he also had a sense of humor in some situations. His sense of justice was strong, and he was quick to lend his mechanical skills when they could solve a problem. He was very confident in his abilities, but his dedication to his work could sometimes isolate him. Despite his taciturn, blunt personality, others respected his hands-on approach and tendency to speak the truth directly. ==Powers and abilities== Tiin had natural [[Telepathy|telepathic powers]] that were superior to most other Jedi,''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' and he was regarded as one of the Order's best [[starfighter]] [[pilot]]s.{{HelmetCollectionCite|55|Databank A-Z}} He was very skilled mechanically, and Master Plo Koon believed that Tiin could fly or repair any vessel ever made. He was also a renowned lightsaber duelist. He was present at the opening foray on Geonosis and was among the small circle of survivors that escaped from the Petranaki arena. As was usual with the Iktotchi species, Tiin's horns would grow back if they were damaged.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' ==Behind the scenes== Saesee Tiin was portrayed and voiced by several actors during the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]: [[Khan Bonfils]] in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], [[Jesse Jensen]] (brother of [[Kit Fisto]]'s actor [[Zachariah Jensen]]) in [[2002]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Kenji Oates]] in [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. For ''The Phantom Menace'', Saesee Tiin's prosthetics were designed and applied by [[Shaune Harrison]].{{WordPress|subdomain=prostheticmakeupfx|url=category/behind-the-scenes/star-wars-episode-1|name=Shaune Harrison|text=A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away… – Working on Star Wars : Episode 1|archivedate=20250716152730}} He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV show. [[File:SaeseeTiinConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Early concept art for Saesee Tiin.]] On playing Tiin in ''Attack of the Clones'', Jesse Jensen's brother Zachariah, who was working as set carpenter, was originally suggested by [[Matt Sloan]] to play Tiin, but after director [[George Lucas]] and producer [[Rick McCallum]] met Zachariah, they gave him the role of Kit Fisto and Jesse was given the part of Tiin.{{SW|url=news/from-concept-to-screen-kit-fisto|text=Kit Fisto: From Concept to Screen|nolive=1}} In the ''Clone Wars'' episode "[[Citadel Rescue]]," Tiin's starfighter was modeled with
